speaker: BARISTA
en: Good morning! What can I get you?

speaker: LENA
es: Un café con leche, por favor.
en: A coffee with milk, please.

speaker: BARISTA
en: For here or to go?

speaker: LENA
es: Para llevar. Tengo un poco de prisa.
en: To go. I'm in a bit of a hurry.

speaker: BARISTA
en: Sure. Anything else?

speaker: LENA
en: No, thanks. How much is it?

speaker: BARISTA
en: That's two euros fifty.

speaker: LENA
en: Can I pay by card?

speaker: BARISTA
en: Yes, no problem.

speaker: MARCO
en: Lena! What are you doing here?

speaker: LENA
en: Marco! What a coincidence.

speaker: MARCO
en: Have you moved in yet?

speaker: LENA
en: Not yet. I'm still looking for a flat.

speaker: MARCO
en: Really? And how is the search going?

speaker: LENA
en: So-so. Everything is really expensive.

speaker: MARCO
en: I know exactly what you mean.

speaker: LENA
es: Hoy tengo una visita a las once.
en: I have a viewing at eleven today.

speaker: MARCO
en: Do you want me to come with you?

speaker: LENA
en: There's no need, but thanks.

speaker: MARCO
en: Hey, it's going to rain. Do you have an umbrella?

speaker: LENA
es: No, se me olvidó en casa.
en: No, I left it at home.

speaker: MARCO
en: Here, take mine.

speaker: LENA
en: Are you sure?

speaker: MARCO
es: Segurísimo. Me lo devuelves esta noche.
en: Absolutely. Give it back to me tonight.

speaker: LENA
en: OK. I owe you one.

speaker: MARCO
es: No te preocupes. ¿Cenamos juntos a las nueve?
en: Don't worry about it. Shall we have dinner at nine?

speaker: LENA
en: That sounds great.

speaker: MARCO
en: Perfect. See you later!

speaker: BARISTA
en: Here's your coffee.

speaker: LENA
es: Muchas gracias. ¡Que tengas un buen día!
en: Thank you very much. Have a nice day!

speaker: LENA
en: Excuse me, could you help me?

speaker: CLERK
en: Of course, go ahead.

speaker: LENA
es: Busco el tren para el centro.
en: I'm looking for the train to the city centre.

speaker: CLERK
en: It leaves from platform four.

speaker: LENA
en: What time does the next one leave?

speaker: CLERK
es: A las diez y cuarto, pero hoy va con retraso.
en: At quarter past ten, but it's running late today.

speaker: LENA
en: Late? How long?

speaker: CLERK
es: Unos veinte minutos, más o menos.
en: About twenty minutes, more or less.

speaker: LENA
es: Vaya. Tengo una cita a las once.
en: Oh no. I have an appointment at eleven.

speaker: CLERK
es: Entonces le conviene tomar el autobús.
en: Then you'd better take the bus.

speaker: LENA
en: Is the stop far from here?

speaker: CLERK
es: No, está a cinco minutos andando.
en: No, it's a five-minute walk.

speaker: CLERK
es: Salga por la puerta principal y gire a la izquierda.
en: Go out the main door and turn left.

speaker: LENA
en: And which bus do I need to take?

speaker: CLERK
es: El treinta y dos. Pasa cada diez minutos.
en: The thirty-two. It comes every ten minutes.

speaker: LENA
en: Could you repeat that, please? More slowly.

speaker: CLERK
es: El treinta y dos, cada diez minutos.
en: The thirty-two, every ten minutes.

speaker: LENA
es: Perfecto. Muchas gracias por su ayuda.
en: Perfect. Thank you very much for your help.

speaker: CLERK
en: You're welcome. Have a good trip!

speaker: LENA
en: Mrs Ortiz? It's Lena.

speaker: LENA
es: Lo siento, voy a llegar un poco tarde.
en: I'm sorry, I'm going to be a bit late.

speaker: ORTIZ
es: No pasa nada. Te espero en el portal.
en: That's fine. I'll wait for you at the entrance.

speaker: LENA
en: Thank you for your patience.

speaker: ORTIZ
es: Pasa, pasa. Este es el salón.
en: Come in, come in. This is the living room.

speaker: LENA
en: It's so bright!

speaker: ORTIZ
es: Da al sur, así que tiene sol toda la tarde.
en: It faces south, so it gets sun all afternoon.

speaker: LENA
en: How many bedrooms does it have?

speaker: ORTIZ
en: Two bedrooms and a bathroom.

speaker: LENA
en: Can I see the kitchen?

speaker: ORTIZ
en: Of course. It has just been renovated.

speaker: LENA
en: How much is the rent per month?

speaker: ORTIZ
en: Eight hundred euros, bills included.

speaker: LENA
en: Does that include heating?

speaker: ORTIZ
es: Sí, la calefacción y el agua.
en: Yes, the heating and the water.

speaker: LENA
en: Is there a deposit?

speaker: ORTIZ
en: Two months' deposit.

speaker: LENA
en: Are pets allowed?

speaker: ORTIZ
en: It depends. What pet do you have?

speaker: LENA
en: A very calm cat.

speaker: ORTIZ
en: A cat is no problem.

speaker: LENA
en: When would it be available?

speaker: ORTIZ
en: From the first of the month.

speaker: ORTIZ
es: Hay otra persona interesada, la verdad.
en: There's someone else interested, to be honest.

speaker: LENA
en: I understand. Let me think about it.

speaker: ORTIZ
en: Of course. Will you let me know tomorrow?

speaker: LENA
es: Sí, le escribo mañana sin falta.
en: Yes, I'll write to you tomorrow without fail.

speaker: ORTIZ
en: Very good. Oh, look how it's raining!

speaker: LENA
en: Good thing I have an umbrella.

speaker: PHARMACIST
es: Buenas tardes. ¿En qué le puedo ayudar?
en: Good afternoon. How can I help you?

speaker: LENA
en: I'm not feeling very well.

speaker: PHARMACIST
en: What's wrong?

speaker: LENA
es: Me duele la garganta y estoy muy cansada.
en: My throat hurts and I'm very tired.

speaker: PHARMACIST
en: Since when?

speaker: LENA
en: Since last night.

speaker: PHARMACIST
en: Do you have a fever?

speaker: LENA
es: Creo que no, pero no estoy segura.
en: I don't think so, but I'm not sure.

speaker: PHARMACIST
es: Le recomiendo estas pastillas para la garganta.
en: I recommend these throat lozenges.

speaker: PHARMACIST
en: Take one every four hours.

speaker: LENA
en: Can I take them on an empty stomach?

speaker: PHARMACIST
en: Better after eating.

speaker: PHARMACIST
en: And drink plenty of water.

speaker: LENA
en: And if I don't get better?

speaker: PHARMACIST
es: Si no mejora en tres días, vaya al médico.
en: If you don't improve in three days, go to the doctor.

speaker: LENA
en: All right. How much do I owe you?

speaker: PHARMACIST
en: Six euros twenty.

speaker: LENA
en: Here you are.

speaker: PHARMACIST
en: Get well soon.

speaker: LENA
en: Thank you, that's very kind.

speaker: MARCO
en: Finally! I thought you weren't coming.

speaker: LENA
en: Sorry, I'm late again.

speaker: MARCO
es: No te preocupes. Acabo de llegar.
en: Don't worry. I've just arrived.

speaker: LENA
es: Toma, tu paraguas. Me ha salvado la vida.
en: Here's your umbrella. It saved my life.

speaker: MARCO
en: How did the viewing go?

speaker: LENA
es: Muy bien. El piso me encanta.
en: Very well. I love the flat.

speaker: MARCO
en: And the price?

speaker: LENA
es: Un poco caro, pero vale la pena.
en: A bit expensive, but it's worth it.

speaker: MARCO
en: Are you going to take it?

speaker: LENA
es: Creo que sí. Mañana le escribo a la dueña.
en: I think so. I'll write to the owner tomorrow.

speaker: MARCO
en: Congratulations! We have to celebrate.

speaker: WAITER
en: What will you have?

speaker: LENA
en: What do you recommend?

speaker: WAITER
es: La paella está muy buena hoy.
en: The paella is very good today.

speaker: MARCO
en: Then two paellas, please.

speaker: LENA
es: Y una botella de agua sin gas.
en: And a bottle of still water.

speaker: WAITER
en: Right away.

speaker: MARCO
en: Hey, are you OK? You don't look well.

speaker: LENA
es: Estoy un poco resfriada, nada más.
en: I've got a bit of a cold, that's all.

speaker: MARCO
es: Deberías descansar este fin de semana.
en: You should rest this weekend.

speaker: LENA
es: Tienes razón. Pero tengo mil cosas que hacer.
en: You're right. But I have a thousand things to do.

speaker: MARCO
es: ¿Te echo una mano con la mudanza?
en: Shall I give you a hand with the move?

speaker: LENA
en: Really? That would be great.

speaker: MARCO
es: Claro. Para eso están los amigos.
en: Of course. That's what friends are for.

speaker: LENA
en: I owe you one, again.

speaker: MARCO
en: You owe me two. But who's counting?

speaker: LENA
en: What do you mean by that?

speaker: MARCO
es: Que me invites a la próxima cena.
en: That you buy me the next dinner.

speaker: LENA
en: It's a deal.

speaker: WAITER
en: Here you are. Enjoy your meal!

speaker: LENA
en: That looks delicious!

speaker: MARCO
en: To the new flat.

speaker: LENA
en: Cheers!

speaker: LENA
en: By the way, is it still raining?

speaker: MARCO
en: It's pouring.

speaker: LENA
es: Entonces me vuelves a prestar el paraguas.
en: Then you're lending me the umbrella again.

speaker: MARCO
es: Ni hablar. Esta vez te acompaño a casa.
en: No way. This time I'll walk you home.

speaker: LENA
en: You're a sweetheart.
